intro.title: FUNDA — Parallel API Dashboard Card
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Parallel API Dashboard Card — a stats widget that simultaneously fetches data from three different API endpoints (user count, revenue total, and active sessions) and renders a composite card once all data is ready, with per-source error handling that shows a partial result if one API fails rather than blanking the entire card. You will use forkJoin with individual catchError wrappers for fault tolerance, model the card's state using NgRx ComponentStore as a local state container, and animate the count values from 0 to their final values on first load.
intro.usecase: Analytics dashboards, executive summary cards, and KPI widgets aggregate data from multiple backend services simultaneously. The correct implementation uses parallel requests with forkJoin and degrades gracefully when individual sources fail.
